test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 2 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘CURD’ is written as ‘342184’ and ‘BREAD’ is written as ‘2181024’. How will ‘BUTTER’ be written in that language?
solution:
According to the English alphabet series and its positional value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

The logic follows here is: 

**The positional values of the vowels, i.e. A, E, I, O, U are doubled, rest has same positional values.**

 
• CURD → 342184

 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef0c6967b6135c32940f5193ef2bd665b4aaec8cfa6f30cbf81594f29d9fa257.png] 
 
 
 
• BREAD → 2181024
 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b242a882a5defd73c4ea7ddd9001d6fbf6b90a29147ced1d73fb24d190aa794.png] 
 
 
 
• Similarly,** BUTTER → **
 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6770457a8c0e0a7d4d5fc1e0e0b70f5e12cb7f80f2722e663265952dec9a24e.png] 
 
 

​So, **24220201018 **is the correct answer.
